who_may_join.text: The study includes women over 55 who have had no major health problems and have had a broken bone in their spine or another part of their body due to weak bones.

procedures_or_participation.text: Women in the study need to have X-rays taken of their back and lower part of their body to check their bone strength. They also need to take a special test to measure their bone density.

patient_facing_summary.text: Older women who have had broken bones in their spines or other parts of their body due to weak bones can join this study. They need to have X-rays taken and a bone density test. There are no specific risks, but it's not clear how much time they need to commit.
